text:
laura_partnerships: FYI MeridianHealth devops reached out — they want a joint POC inside their VPC (private subnets), SSO via SAML + SCIM, and strict egress allowlist. Asking for a quick cost ballpark and a tenant provisioning + network runbook. Can we triage?

omar_solutions: Thanks — quick Qs to scope: expected peak qps, typical prompt/response token lengths, which model families they plan to use (13B vs 70B), and whether KV cache persistence across sessions is required.

marco_eng: For the VPC flow we need two concrete things from Meridian: 1) egress CIDRs to allow, 2) estimate of peak concurrent streams for sizing Dedicated. Also: what latency SLO are they targeting?

sophie_security: Heads up — we'll need to run their security questionnaire. Key items I expect: data residency, KMS/HSM requirements, audit log retention, whether we will ever process PHI, and SCIM provisioning details.

laura_partnerships: Their answers so far: peak ~50 qps, steady ~20 qps; primary models will be a mix of 13B for most traffic and occasional 70B for heavy cases (they prefer 13B for cost). Latency target is <200ms p50 for 13B. They said no PHI but there is some user PII. Requesting pricing for: 1) Hosted API only, 2) Private deployment in their VPC (control plane managed by us) + egress, and 3) Dedicated reserved pool.

omar_solutions: OK. For a ballpark pricing we need median token/sec and expected session retention (affects KV store). I'll draft a pricing note covering hosted per-token, Dedicated monthly commit ranges, burst/overflow pricing to hosted, and an onboarding fee for private VPC. Who can confirm prompt sizes?

marco_eng: Technical note — with 50 qps on 13B we estimate requiring ~4-6 A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom; 70B spikes should be routed to hosted fallback unless they want large burst capacity (which ups cost). Example of the kind of egress allowlist we will need from them (placeholder until infra confirms exact IPs):

```
- control-plane.redwood.ai: 52.12.34.0/24
- telemetry.redwood.ai: 54.23.45.0/24
- metrics.ingest.redwood.ai: 3.18.12.0/24
```

We'll provide a canonical, signed list once infra validates. Also, for SCIM we typically require a service account with write scope for group/user provisioning.

sophie_security: I will start drafting the questionnaire responses using our payer-health template as a baseline and redline for Meridian specifics. @laura_partnerships please upload the questionnaire they sent and any SOC2 certs if provided. Note: if they insist on HSM-backed KMS, plan +2 weeks on onboarding.

deploy-bot: Tenant provisioning template created: https://internal.redwood/tenants/meridian-poc — includes SSO checklist, network checklist, and tenant variables.

laura_partnerships: Meridian contact: devops@meridianhealth.com — sending their questionnaire now. Can someone own the pricing draft by EOD? They want a tight turnaround.

omar_solutions: I'll own pricing. Draft will include: hosted per-token tiers, Dedicated monthly commit bands (with examples for 4 vs 8 GPU configs), burst routing costs, and a one-time private-deploy onboarding fee. I'll need median token/sec and average prompt+completion lengths — @laura_partnerships can you get sample prompts?

marco_eng: I'll run a quick capacity sim and share a minimal canary config (hosted-to-dedicated routing) and a recommended Dedicated size. Also adding a note: persistent KV (for long-lived sessions) requires attached fast storage; that affects cost/ops.

sophie_security: I'll attach the drafted questionnaire responses here when ready and ping legal if any redlines around PII retention come up. :thumbsup:

laura_partnerships: Great — scheduling a sync with Meridian tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: security Qs, network allowlist, pricing options, minimal canary rollout plan, and success criteria for the 2-week POC window. Owners: @omar_solutions pricing, @marco_eng infra/canary, @sophie_security sec + questionnaire.

omar_solutions: Ack — I'll DM Meridian for prompt length samples before EOD and share pricing draft in this thread.

marco_eng: Ack — I'll post the capacity sim and a minimal kube/proxy snippet for the canary by EOD.

sophie_security: Ack — I'll drop the questionnaire draft and highlight any blockers.

laura_partnerships: Thanks team. Quick note from Meridian: they prefer the canary to be deployable within 48 hours of signing the PO. We'll prioritize the hosted-to-dedicated fallback so they can validate integrations early in the window.
